# velin-counter

Animated number counter (bridges to `<velin-counter>`).

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| number | Target value to animate toward | `<velin-counter>` |
## Example

```html
<div velin-counter>…</div>
```
